what_it_means_title: What this scan can and cannot tell you
what_it_means_desc: A clean result confirms that no known scam indicators were detected at this moment. However, scammers invent new techniques daily. BaitCheck never gives a legal guarantee of safety: never share passwords, OTPs, or enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
action_danger_1: Do not tap on any link and do not download any APK files.
action_danger_2: Do not enter your UPI PIN. PIN is NEVER required to receive money.
action_danger_3: Report suspicious calls or SMS on Chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in) and dial 1930.
action_caution_1: Do not act under urgency. Verify directly in the official app or bank branch.
action_caution_2: Never share an OTP, NetBanking password, or debit card CVV with anyone.
action_caution_3: If this claims to be someone you know, contact them independently on their known phone number.
action_safe_1: Never share OTPs or passwords with callers, even if they claim to represent your bank.
action_safe_2: Verify any debited or credited transaction in your official bank statement.
how_it_works_title: How BaitCheck protects you in 4 steps
step_1_desc: Paste an SMS, link, WhatsApp forward, email, phone number, or scan a payment QR code.
step_2_desc: Removes leetspeak, homoglyphs, and spaced-out letters designed to evade spam filters.
step_3_desc: Inspects domain authenticity, urgency coercion, credential demands, and 50+ known patterns.
step_4_desc: Get a transparent score you can argue with, evidence chips, and 1-tap reporting to 1930.
faq_1_q: Does my message or personal information leave my device?
faq_1_a: Never. All text analysis, pattern matching, URL inspection, and QR decoding execute 100% locally on your browser. No server receives your message.
faq_2_q: Can BaitCheck prove that something is 100% safe?
faq_2_a: No tool can mathematically guarantee that a message is completely safe. We state 'No warning signs found' based on 14 strict heuristic checks and known scam patterns. Always remain cautious.
faq_3_a: Yes, permanently free and open-source for public consumer safety. No account registration, subscription, or ads.
faq_4_q: What should I do if I have already lost money to fraud?
faq_4_a: Call the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930 immediately. Every minute matters to freeze fraudulent recipient accounts.
